newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan stocks hit third straight record.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan stocks hit third straight record.

text.p: Caracas stocks rose to record highs for the third consecutive session on strong foreign bidding, traders said.
The market's 19-share .IBC index gained 1.27 percent to close at 4,864.90 points according to preliminary figures from the stock exchange.
Volume was further boosted by strong trade in Mantex, up 1.25 bolivars to end at 39.25, and steel producer Sivensa, up 5.00 bolivars to close at 307.00.
"Foreigners feel good about Venezuela at the moment, especially its privatization program," said Intervalores broker Ricardo Marino. "I believe the bolsa could continue rising."
